title: Dup15q model mice exhibit impaired gastrointestinal motility and a constipation-like phenotype, alleviated by prucalopride.
abstract: Dup15q (15q11.2-q13 duplication) is an ASD-linked CNV encoding GABA-A receptor subunits. 15q dup mice showed elevated colonic GABA receptor gene expression, reduced Tph2/Htr4, delayed GI transit and slower colonic motility; the GABA-A antagonist bicuculline worsened contractions. The 5-HT4 agonist prucalopride restored GI transit and improved social interaction.
